Compute a stationary distribution, fit smoothed character transitions, score held-out text, and generate a sample.

## Part A · Worksheet (~40 min, pen and paper)

### Problem 1 — Stationary distribution ⭐

For $P=\begin{bmatrix}.8 & .2 \\ .4 & .6\end{bmatrix}$ over states $(S,R)$, solve $\pi=\pi P$ and normalize.

### Problem 2 — Path probability ⭐

With states ordered $(S,R)$ and initial distribution $(.6,.4)$, find $P(S,R,R,S)$.

### Problem 3 — Transition MLE ⭐⭐

Derive the MLE row from counts $n_{ij}$ under the row-sum constraint.

### Problem 4 — Smoothing ⭐

Apply add-one prediction to counts $(8,2,0,0)$.

### Problem 5 — BPC ⭐⭐

If test transitions receive probabilities $(1/2,1/4,1/8)$, compute total bits, BPC, and perplexity.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Solutions — open only after attempting everything

**1.** Balance the cross-flows: $.2 \pi(S)=.4 \pi(R)$, so $\pi(S)=2 \pi(R)$; normalizing gives $\pi=(2/3,1/3)$.

**2.** Initial probability times three transition probabilities: $0.6(.2)(.6)(.4)=.0288$.

**3.** Maximizing $\sum_j n_{ij} \log P_{ij}$ with each row summing to one gives the count fractions $\hat{P}_{ij}=n_{ij}/\sum_j n_{ij}$.

**4.** Add one to every count and renormalize: $(9,3,1,1)/14$ — unseen transitions get $1/14$ instead of an impossible zero.

**5.** Each transition costs $-\log_2$ of its probability: $1+2+3=6$ bits total, $6/3=2$ BPC, perplexity $2^2=4$.
:::
